scope: Unchanged late-endpoint mass current in the homogeneous classical dust reference, unit comoving ball volume, Ts=6piG=c=M=1. Same s,P,F as the preceding four-window test.
gate: For each high-density cell require at least 95% of individual corrected masses within [0.9,1.1]. Reject if simultaneous upper bound for coverage <0.95. Otherwise unresolved unless supported by independent direct qualification.
uncertainty: 99% simultaneous family coverage. Bonferroni allocation over 4 high-density cells times 6 fixed difference thresholds and the 4 direct gate frequencies (two bounds each). Use exact one-sided binomial Clopper-Pearson limits. Full sample SD, RMSE and quantiles descriptive; high-density population variance lower bounded using clipped paired differences and disjoint terminal caps.
stopping: Fixed sample sizes. Independent parent Poisson clouds across repetitions and cells; two replacement caps share the entire exterior within one pair. Prespecified fallback for speed: write completed row counts, no extrapolation or changing thresholds.
